## Version / environment
Commit, Node version, OS, browser, device. Local / tunnel / offline?

## Steps, expected and actual behavior
Use synthetic demo wherever possible.

## Sanitized evidence
Errors/screenshots only after removing tokens, paired URLs, company drawing details and personal data.

## Data recovery status
Pending queue? Exported results saved? Do not clear browser storage during investigation.
